A visual family describes repeat exposure, not identical SKU, pattern, physical fit, material composition or permission to promote QA state.
Distinct groups can still share materials and design language. Singletons mean no family confirmed in this candidate set, not globally unique across all possible garment pairs.

The existing 443-pair machine queue, historical native notes and six exact-descriptor groups are reviewed; exhaustive all-pairs recall for 600 garments is unknown. No claim that every similar pair has been found.
